Connecting lets this app keep a backup in a private, hidden area of your own Google Drive, which only this app can use. You can always back up by hand on this screen, and optionally let the app back up automatically - only when you have turned automatic backup on, and only into that same hidden folder. Offline use never needs Drive, and the app never asks for it when it starts.

The app asks Google for one permission: access to its own hidden application-data folder in your Drive. It does not request your profile, email address, or other Drive files. There is no account with us and no server of ours. Access tokens are kept only in memory and are never saved or logged. Anything stored in your Drive will be protected by your Google account, not by extra encryption from this app. Disconnecting does not delete data already in your Drive.
Could not open your Google Account settings.

Your transactions, budgets and goals are stored only on this device. The app has no account with us, no server, and it uses no analytics.

If you choose to connect Google Drive, the app asks for access to its own hidden folder in your Drive and nothing else. Backups are written to that hidden folder only. If you turn automatic backup on, the app copies the same backup data to that folder on a schedule you choose; when an automatic backup succeeds, older automatic backup files are removed from that hidden folder so only the newest backup remains. Nothing is uploaded while automatic backup is off, and you can turn it off at any time on the Backup and restore screen.

Disconnecting Google Drive withdraws the app's access. Your data on this device is not touched, and anything already stored in your Drive folder by the app stays there - in the hidden folder, outside the normal Drive interface. To remove it from Google entirely, use Drive's Settings > Manage apps, or delete your Drive data.

The app does not provide extra encryption of its own for data in Google Drive; the data there is protected by your Google account. Local backups and the database itself are stored unencrypted in your device's private app storage, like other app data. If Android's own system backup is turned on in your device settings, Android may also include this app's data in your Google account backup; that backup is managed by Android and your Google account, not by this app.

Advertising: this app shows a small banner ad below the content on the main screens and, at most once every ten minutes, a full-screen ad when you close the Insights screen, both served by the Google Mobile Ads SDK (Google AdMob). It is the only advertising software in the app; the app itself has no analytics and sends no diagnostic or crash data anywhere. Because it serves ads, Google's SDK processes advertising-related data such as ad requests and the device's advertising identifier according to Google's own policies and to the consent choices you make.

Ads are never shown while you enter or edit a transaction, or during backups, restores, exports or confirmation dialogs, and no feature is locked behind an ad. Where consent is required and you decline, ads are not personalized. Your consent choices can be reviewed at any time under Settings > Ad privacy options (when your region requires the entry point). Your expense data stays on this device: advertising never reads your transactions, budgets, goals or backups.

When this is on, the app keeps its backup up to date on its own: it copies the same backup data as the button above (all your transactions, budgets, savings goals, categories and the app\'s settings) to the hidden app folder in your Google Drive - %1$s, roughly around %2$s. Only the newest backup is kept in Drive: it replaces the previous one, and only after the replacement has been fully uploaded and checked.\n\nBackground jobs can be delayed by Android (battery saving, Doze mode, connection availability), so the time is never exact. Nothing is uploaded before you turn this on, and the app works fully offline as before.
Automatic backup is off. The app only backs up when you tap Back up now.

With automatic backup on, this app copies your backup data (transactions, budgets, savings goals, categories and settings) to its hidden folder in your Google Drive on a schedule. You can turn it off here at any time. Turning it on requires a connected Google Drive; the app never uploads anything while automatic backup is off.
The scheduled background backup will be cancelled. Your data on this device is unchanged, and anything already in your Drive stays there. You can still back up at any time by hand.
